ripe_catch.title: Ripe Catch
ripe_catch.hint_pc: Move the basket with the mouse (or A/D, left/right).
ripe_catch.hint_phone: Drag anywhere to move the basket.

splitting_stone.title: Splitting Stone
splitting_stone.hint_pc: Hit each rune as it lights, in order (or 1, 2, 3).
splitting_stone.hint_phone: Tap each rune as it lights, in order.

woodsong.title: Woodsong
woodsong.hint_pc: Strike on the beat (mouse or Space). Gold beats count double.
woodsong.hint_phone: Tap anywhere on the beat. Gold beats count double.

just_enough.title: Just Enough
just_enough.hint_pc: Hold to pour, let go in the band (mouse or Space).
just_enough.hint_phone: Hold anywhere to pour, let go in the band.

steady_press.title: Steady Press
steady_press.hint_pc: Circle the wheel, ease off in the green (or alternate A/D).
steady_press.hint_phone: Circle the wheel to build pressure, ease off in the green.

with_the_grain.title: With the Grain
with_the_grain.hint_pc: Drag from the gold ring along the grain.
with_the_grain.hint_phone: Drag from the gold ring along the grain.

steeping.title: Steeping
steeping.hint_pc: Watch the order, then pick the herbs (or 1-5). R shows it again.
steeping.hint_phone: Watch the order, then tap the herbs.
